title: CBR What Not Do
description: Lists the most dangerous mistakes in chemical, biological, and radiological emergencies, starting with using the wrong shelter room, going outside to collect family, and sheltering in a car. Covers myths about conditioner, hand sanitizer, and alcohol, potassium iodide misuse, sealed-room time limits, and misinformation.
shortDescription: Wrong shelter room, going out for family, cars, KI misuse, and other mistakes
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
